title: The sound of it
logline: A page with the glow out of frame and only its sound: a jagged shape, the strip's bell shape, the mill's whistle shape, laid between the trunks from the right edge. Whether it's the mill's whistle the page doesn't say. The dog's ears up.

panels.composition: Cedar trunks close, the light warm from the right edge but its source out of frame, and a long jagged sound shape laid between the trunks from that edge, a small three-legged dog with its ears up.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, close cedar trunks lit warm from the right edge by a source out of frame with a long jagged sound shape laid between the trunks from that side and a small three-legged dog with its ears up, no words
image.notes: The whistle shape (ro_2022-12-11) and the bell shape: the same shape. Not said.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The sound of it. The whistle's shape, maybe.
